name: cupertino-figma-tools
description: Generate CupertinoAvalonia's design tokens from your own local copy of Apple's macOS Figma kit

scripts.generate: npm run extract && npm run tokens
scripts.extract: unzip -o -q ../../design/source/macOS-27.fig canvas.fig -d ../../design/source/unpacked && node decode.js ../../design/source/unpacked/canvas.fig ../../design/source/unpacked/canvas.json && node extract-tokens.js ../../design/source/unpacked/canvas.json ../../design/extracted
